question.text: Under SEBI (ICDR) Reg 292D and related operational guidelines, the minimum tenure of a Zero Coupon Zero Principal (ZCZP) instrument issued by an NPO on the SSE is:

explanation.text: The Logic: ZCZP instruments are non-interest-bearing and non-principal-repaying philanthropic contributions whose tenure is linked to the programme they fund. SEBI's operational guidelines for ZCZP issuance under the SSE framework prescribe a defined minimum tenure to give the funded project enough time to be executed and for outcomes to be assessed. A 3-year minimum is the figure used in practice and provides space for at least two SIA-certified Annual Impact Reports during the instrument's life. The Trap: 6 months and 1 year are too short for meaningful outcome measurement. 5 years overstates the minimum, although longer voluntary tenures are permitted. Note: The cited SIA workbook (pp. 69-70) states that ZCZP instruments have a tenure equal to the duration of the funded project, but does not specifically state a minimum tenure of three years on the pages checked. The 3-year minimum framing above is drawn from SEBI's broader ICDR/SSE operational guidelines rather than a workbook-page citation.
